title: Commercial establishment contract query processed
description: One page of the result of the query of the commercial establishments that have a contract with a debtor. One event is emitted per page of 100 items to the commercial_establishment_contract_query_processed event type. Produced by ce-api, the Tangara commercial establishment service, and not by the legacy commercial-establishment-api.

debtor.title: Debtor document number
debtor.description: Debtor document number that was queried

b3RegisteredAt.title: B3 registered at
b3RegisteredAt.description: Value of the request header b3-registered-at, returned unchanged. Omitted when the header is not sent

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Maximum number of items in a page

totalElements.title: Total elements
totalElements.description: Number of commercial establishments in the whole result

totalPages.title: Total pages
totalPages.description: Number of pages in the whole result

commercialEstablishments.title: Commercial establishments
commercialEstablishments.description: Commercial establishments of this page. May be empty

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.description: Document type of the commercial establishment. [CPF] [CNPJ]
